paragraphs: R' Levitas Ḥoza'ah (חוזאה). Mentioned in Zohar Chadash, beginning of Eichah (Lamentations).[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Ḥoza’ah transliterates חוזאה without adding “of” or deciding whether it is an epithet or gentilic. The supplied name לויטס חוזאה differs from earlier machine OCR לוימם חזאה; English vowels remain conventional. The abbreviated title remains R'.
ריש איכה means beginning of Eichah (Lamentations). Hyman cites Zohar Chadash without finer numbering or a named edition.
This renders Hyman’s supplied citation; its occurrence and edition-specific locator have not been independently checked.
